news.title: Stall No. 6 Is Fresh Out The Fryer
news.body: The next Berempah Bros counter is confirmed and coming to a hawker centre near you. Location, opening date and (maybe) an opening special drop first on Instagram, so keep an eye on @berempahbros.

news.title: Introducing Our New Duck Confit Berempah
news.imageAlt: A glazed, crumb-topped berempah plate on a rattan tray
news.body: The Bros went French, then dragged it straight back to the kopitiam: **Duck Confit Berempah**: slow-cooked duck leg, crisped up and hit with the signature rempah treatment. On the menu at **Gepuk Guys, Bedok** at $16.50, as covered by [Eatbook](https://eatbook.sg/gepuk-guys/).

news.title: Say Hello To Gepuk Guys
news.imageAlt: A loaded rattan tray of gepuk-style dishes with rice, sambal and sides
news.body:
Our sister stall is live. **Gepuk Guys** serves Indonesian-inspired gepuk (turmeric-marinated fried chicken, lightly smashed, with cashew-nut sambal) from Stall 3, Jofa Coffeeshop, **531 Bedok North Street 3**, daily 10:30am–10:30pm.

Mains from $9.90 (Ayam Berempah Gepuk), with grilled squid, unagi and duck confit on the roster. **No pork, no lard** at this one. Full story on [Eatbook](https://eatbook.sg/gepuk-guys/).

news.title: Stall No. 4: Woodleigh Village
news.body: The fourth Berempah Bros counter opened at **Woodleigh Village Hawker Centre**, 202C Bidadari Park Drive, right by Woodleigh MRT (NE11). Same overnight rempah, same crunch, now for the Bidadari side of town.

news.title: Sengkang, We're In: Happy Hawkers
news.body: Stall No. 3 landed at **Happy Hawkers, 267 Compassvale Link**, right next to Ranggung LRT. The opening ran a Pork Berempah special that had the queue snaking past the drinks stall, and northeast-siders have kept it moving since.

news.title: Where It Started: Beauty World
news.imageAlt: Two plates of ayam berempah on the hawker table at the stall
news.body:
MasterChef Singapore champion **Derek Cheong** opened the first Berempah Bros at **Beauty World Food Centre #04-51** with one dish, done properly: 16-spice ayam goreng berempah under a shower of garlic, breadcrumb, kerisik and sakura ebi crunch.

The food blogs came fast. [DanielFoodDiary](https://danielfooddiary.com/2026/01/19/berempahbros/) compared the crumbs to "a lovechild between prawn cereal and HK-style typhoon shelter crab toppings," and the queues haven't really stopped.

home.tag: by MasterChef Singapore champion Derek Cheong
home.intro: Ayam goreng berempah, marinated overnight in sixteen spices, fried to order and finished with fried garlic, kerisik and sakura ebi. On coconut rice, at hawker centres across Singapore.

story.heading:
Born In Singapore.
Built On Rempah.
story.body:
Berempah Bros started from our love for the food we grew up eating.

The flavours of Singapore and Southeast Asia are loud, diverse and unapologetic: sambal, coconut, spices, smoke, char and plenty of rempah. We wanted to build something around that.

Our starting point was the humble plate of nasi lemak. We took everything we loved about it and made it our own: fragrant coconut rice, punchy sambal, refreshing achar and, at the centre of it all, our signature **Ayam Berempah**.

What began with one plate has grown into different proteins, grilled dishes, new creations and Berempah Bros outlets across Singapore.

But the idea hasn't changed.

**Take familiar flavours. Put our spin on them. And make food we'd happily eat ourselves.**

careers.heading: Join The Bros.
careers.intro:
**Good food doesn't happen without good people.**

We're growing, and we're always looking for people who want to grow with us.

Whether you're looking to start your journey in F&B or already have years of experience, we're looking for people with the right attitude, energy and willingness to learn.
careers.note: experience is great. attitude matters more.
